entities.name: UniProt A7IEQ6
observations: Exact full-length sequence match (100% identity and coverage) to reviewed Xanthobacter versatilis glucose-6-phosphate isomerase, UniProt A7IEQ6.
Length 547 aa; calculated molecular mass 58,311.5 Da; theoretical pI 5.20.
Annotated as cytoplasmic glucose-6-phosphate isomerase (EC 5.3.1.9), catalyzing reversible glucose-6-phosphate/fructose-6-phosphate interconversion.
PGI family domain PF00342 spans residues 49–538 in sequence-based scan.
